name: AmCraX baseline ammonia-cracking flowsheet
description: Single source of truth for flowsheet topology. Used by the Aspen input-file generator, the Python process model, the API (/api/flowsheet) and the React Flow PFD. Block and stream IDs are the Aspen Plus IDs.

blocks.name: Ammonia feed pump
blocks.role: Raises refrigerated liquid ammonia from storage pressure (1.013 bar) to the reactor-train pressure. Pumping a liquid is far cheaper than compressing the cracked gas.

blocks.name: Ammonia vaporiser
blocks.role: Vaporises the pressurised liquid ammonia and superheats it by 10 K so that the downstream exchanger handles single-phase gas.

blocks.name: Feed/effluent heat exchanger
blocks.role: Recovers sensible heat from the hot cracked gas to preheat the ammonia feed. Only present when heat integration is enabled.

blocks.name: Fired trim preheater
blocks.role: Raises the preheated ammonia to the reactor inlet temperature.

blocks.name: Ammonia cracking reactor
blocks.role: Isothermal equilibrium reactor (Gibbs free-energy minimisation) for 2 NH3 <-> N2 + 3 H2. Its duty is the endothermic heat of reaction.

blocks.name: Cracked-gas cooler
blocks.role: Cools the cracked gas leaving the FEHE to the purification feed temperature.

blocks.name: Hydrogen purification (reduced-order PSA)
blocks.role: Component splitter with specified H2 recovery and N2 slip. It represents the material balance of a PSA unit; it is NOT a designed adsorption model.

blocks.name: Tail-gas burner
blocks.role: Adiabatic complete combustion of the PSA tail gas (unrecovered H2, residual NH3, N2) with air.

blocks.name: Flue-gas heat recovery
blocks.role: Cools the flue gas to the stack temperature. Its duty is the heat available from tail-gas combustion, compared with the process heat demand in the heat-integration analysis.

pressure_profile_bar_relative_to_reactor.comment: Pressures are set relative to the reactor outlet pressure P (CaseInputs.reactor_pressure_bar).

feed.condition: saturated liquid at 1.013 bar (refrigerated storage, about -33 degC)
